tron lightcycle.ecvPolicy: Transfer to Lightcycle or Rear Bench
tron lightcycle.ecvDetailNote: All bags must go in the free lockers inside the queue. ECV users transfer to a manual wheelchair; a standard seated bench car is available at the rear of select trains upon request.
tron lightcycle.description: Launch at nearly 60 mph onto the Grid aboard a futuristic Lightcycle in one of the fastest coasters at any Disney theme park.

seven dwarfs mine train.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue, then transfer into the swinging mine cart.
seven dwarfs mine train.description: Race through the diamond mine from Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs aboard gently swaying mine carts.

tiana's bayou adventure.ecvDetailNote: Transfer from ECV to a manual wheelchair for the queue, then step down into the log. Expect a 50-foot splashdown drop.
tiana's bayou adventure.description: Join Princess Tiana and Louis on a musical journey through the bayou featuring dozens of Audio-Animatronics and a thrilling 50-foot plunge.

space mountain.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue. Rocket seats sit low to the floor and require stepping down into the vehicle.
space mountain.description: Blast off into pitch-black outer space on Magic Kingdom's iconic indoor roller coaster filled with sharp dips and turns.

big thunder mountain.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue; standard coaster seat transfer at load.
big thunder mountain.description: Careen through a haunted gold-mining town and newly enhanced glowing Rainbow Caverns on the wildest ride in the wilderness.

haunted mansion.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair. Cast Members can slow or stop the moving walkway belt for easier boarding into the Doom Buggy.
haunted mansion.description: Glide through a spirited estate inhabited by 999 happy haunts aboard a Doom Buggy.

pirates of the caribbean.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a courtesy manual wheelchair at the entrance; guests must step down into the boat.
pirates of the caribbean.description: Set sail past buccaneers, cannon fire, and Captain Jack Sparrow in a classic indoor boat voyage with one small drop in the dark.

peter pan's flight.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair. Note that the load belt does not stop completely for boarding.
peter pan's flight.description: Soar over London and Never Land aboard a magical flying pirate galleon.

jungle cruise.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated wheelchair-accessible boat with a hydraulic lift allows guests to remain in a manual wheelchair (ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair).
jungle cruise.description: Embark on a pun-filled river expedition led by a witty skipper past animatronic wildlife across the rivers of the world.

space ranger spin.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated accessible Star Cruiser allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard; ECVs transfer to a courtesy wheelchair.
space ranger spin.description: Spin your Star Cruiser and fire upgraded blasters at digital targets to help Buzz Lightyear defeat Emperor Zurg.

it's a small world.ecvDetailNote: Dedicated accessible boats allow guests to remain in a manual wheelchair throughout the voyage.
it's a small world.description: Sail past singing dolls representing cultures from around the globe on a whimsical musical boat tour.

winnie the pooh.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated accessible Hunny Pot allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
winnie the pooh.description: Bounce with Tigger and float through a blustery day in the Hundred Acre Wood aboard a giant Hunny Pot.

under the sea.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated clamshell allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard; the belt can be slowed or stopped.
under the sea.description: Journey beneath the waves aboard a clamshell to relive Ariel's musical story from The Little Mermaid.

dumbo.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; a transfer-assist Dumbo vehicle with a hinged side is available.
dumbo.description: Soar high above Storybook Circus aboard your own flying elephant with an indoor air-conditioned play queue.

barnstormer.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; standard step-over transfer into the stunt plane.
barnstormer.description: Take a short, zippy flight aboard Goofy's homemade stunt plane in Storybook Circus.

mad tea party.ecvDetailNote: Standard wheelchair transfer through the teacup door.
mad tea party.description: Spin as fast or as gently as you like inside giant pastel teacups under glowing Wonderland lanterns.

peoplemover.ecvDetailNote: Requires ascending a steep moving speedramp to reach the elevated rotating load platform.
peoplemover.description: Relax on a breezy 10-minute elevated tour gliding above Tomorrowland and peeking inside Space Mountain.

tomorrowland speedway.minHeight: 32" (81 cm) to Ride, 54" to Drive Alone
tomorrowland speedway.ecvDetailNote: Requires stepping down into the low-slung race car; a transfer-assist device is available.
tomorrowland speedway.description: Steer a gas-powered race car along a guided track winding through Tomorrowland.

astro orbiter.ecvDetailNote: Elevator accesses the upper launch pad; guests must step down into the narrow rocket cockpit.
astro orbiter.description: Pilot a retro rocket ship high above Tomorrowland for panoramic views of Magic Kingdom.

magic carpets.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated accessible carpet allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
magic carpets.description: Fly over Adventureland's Agrabah bazaar while dodging a spitting camel.

regal carrousel.ecvDetailNote: Accessible chariot allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onto the carousel.
regal carrousel.description: Ride one of 90 hand-carved wooden horses on Fantasyland's classic centerpiece carousel.

walt disney world railroad.ecvDetailNote: Ramps at every station allow guests to remain in a manual wheelchair or ECV on board.
walt disney world railroad.description: Circle the entire Magic Kingdom aboard an authentic vintage steam train.

cosmic rewind.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair before the preshow. A dedicated transfer car with a side opening is available on request.
cosmic rewind.description: Help the Guardians of the Galaxy save the galaxy on EPCOT's massive indoor storytelling coaster with a reverse launch and 360-degree rotating vehicles.

remy's ratatouille adventure.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; a dedicated accessible rat mobile allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
remy's ratatouille adventure.description: Shrink to the size of Chef Remy and scurry through Gusteau's bustling Paris kitchen in a trackless 4D adventure.

frozen ever after.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue, then step down into the Viking boat.
frozen ever after.description: Sail through Arendelle to Elsa's Ice Palace on a musical boat ride featuring a small backwards drop.

test track.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue; a transfer-assist device is available at the load platform.
test track.description: Experience EPCOT's newly reimagined celebration of automotive innovation before bursting outdoors onto a banked 65-mph high-speed loop.

soarin.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can stay with you through the queue right up to the theater doors before transferring into the glider seat.
soarin.description: Lift off into a massive IMAX dome for Soarin' Across America, a breezy hang-gliding flight over iconic U.S. landscapes and landmarks.

mission: space.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair. Orange Mission uses intense G-force spinning; Green Mission offers gentle motion without spinning.
mission: space.description: Choose between an intense G-force flight to Mars (Orange) or a gentle orbit around Earth (Green) inside a tight space capsule.

spaceship earth.ecvDetailNote: Enter through the exit-side accessible queue; Cast Members can slow or stop the moving walkway for boarding.
spaceship earth.description: Travel through the history of human communication inside EPCOT's iconic 18-story geodesic sphere.

living with the land.ecvDetailNote: Dedicated accessible boats allow guests to remain in a manual wheelchair.
living with the land.description: Cruise through working hydroponic greenhouses and fish farms where EPCOT grows produce served in its restaurants.

seas with nemo.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated accessible Clamobile allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
seas with nemo.description: Board a Clamobile to find Nemo before exiting directly into a massive 5.7-million-gallon saltwater aquarium.

figment.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated accessible vehicle allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
figment.description: Tour the Imagination Institute's sensory labs with Dr. Nigel Channing and the mischievous purple dragon Figment.

gran fiesta tour.ecvDetailNote: Dedicated accessible boats allow manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
gran fiesta tour.description: Float past a Mayan pyramid inside the Mexico pavilion while searching for Donald Duck with the Three Caballeros.

rise of the resistance.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can navigate the queue and preshow areas right up to the interrogation room before transferring to the trackless troop transport.
rise of the resistance.description: Join the Resistance in a massive multi-stage attraction where you are captured by a First Order Star Destroyer and must escape Kylo Ren.

slinky dog dash.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue; standard step-over transfer into Slinky Dog's coils.
slinky dog dash.description: Zip and bounce across Andy's backyard on a family-friendly double-launch coaster with great views of Toy Story Land.

tower of terror.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can go through the lobby and boiler room queue right up to the service elevator doors before transferring.
tower of terror.description: Step into the Hollywood Tower Hotel for a haunted elevator plunge with randomized, faster-than-gravity drops.

rock 'n' roller coaster.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue; a transfer-assist vehicle is available at load.
rock 'n' roller coaster.description: Rocket from 0 to 57 mph in 2.8 seconds straight into three inversions in the dark starring The Muppets and Dr. Teeth and the Electric Mayhem.

runaway railway.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can go through the Chinese Theatre queue up to the boarding area before transferring into the train car.
runaway railway.description: Step inside a Mickey Mouse cartoon short where anything can happen aboard Engineer Goofy's trackless train.

smugglers run.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; elevator access bypasses the stairs to the Millennium Falcon cockpit.
smugglers run.description: Take the controls of the Millennium Falcon as a Pilot, Gunner, or Engineer on a thrilling mission featuring The Mandalorian and Grogu.

toy story mania.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; a dedicated accessible carnival car allows manual wheelchairs to roll straight onboard.
toy story mania.description: Compete in fast-paced 3D carnival midway games hosted by Woody, Buzz, and the Toy Story gang.

alien swirling saucers.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; standard step-in transfer into the space rocket.
alien swirling saucers.description: Whip around glowing turntables pulled by playful Toy Story Aliens to upbeat electronic space tunes.

star tours.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can stay with you right up to the Starspeeder boarding door before transferring.
star tours.description: Jump to hyperspace with C-3PO across randomized Star Wars destinations in a 3D motion simulator.

flight of passage.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue. Guests must straddle the motorbike-style Link Chair with back and calf restraints.
flight of passage.description: Link to an Avatar and soar across the floating mountains of Pandora on the back of a breathing banshee.

na'vi river journey.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue, then step down into the reed boat.
na'vi river journey.description: Drift gently through Pandora's glowing bioluminescent rainforest to meet the Na'vi Shaman of Songs.

expedition everest.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue; standard coaster seat transfer at load.
expedition everest.description: Climb the Himalayan peaks by steam train before a broken track sends you hurtling backwards in the dark to escape the Yeti.

kilimanjaro safaris.ecvDetailNote: ECVs can stay with you through the queue; dedicated safari trucks allow guests to remain in a manual wheelchair or ECV.
kilimanjaro safaris.description: Tour the Harambe Wildlife Reserve aboard an open-air safari truck to spot giraffes, elephants, lions, and rhinos.

kali river rapids.ecvDetailNote: A dedicated transfer raft with a hydraulic lift is available; expect to get thoroughly drenched.
kali river rapids.description: Plunge down a rushing Asian river through geysers and waterfalls aboard a spinning 12-person raft.

wildlife express.ecvDetailNote: Ramp access allows guests to remain in a manual wheelchair or ECV.
wildlife express.description: Ride a rustic African train to Conservation Station for Bluey's Wild World, interactive animal care exhibits, and a petting zoo.

crush 'n' gusher.ecvDetailNote: Requires climbing stairs to the slide launch platform and transferring into an inflatable tube.
crush 'n' gusher.description: Blast uphill and down plunges through an abandoned tropical fruit processing plant on a water coaster.

miss adventure falls.ecvDetailNote: Board the four-person raft at ground level and ride a conveyor belt to the top of the slide.
miss adventure falls.description: Board a treasure hunter's family raft for a twisting white-water splashdown past an animatronic parrot.

summit plummet.ecvDetailNote: Accessible via the Mount Gushmore Chairlift (wheelchair gondola available) or stairs, then body-slide entry.
summit plummet.description: Plunge nearly straight down a 120-foot ski jump at up to 60 mph on one of the tallest free-fall body slides in the world.

teamboat springs.ecvDetailNote: One of the longest family white-water raft rides in the world, seating up to 6 guests.
teamboat springs.description: Twist and splash down 1,200 feet of banked snowy rapids in a giant family raft.

happily ever after.description: Magic Kingdom's signature nighttime fireworks and projection spectacular over Cinderella Castle.

disney starlight.description: Magic Kingdom's dazzling nighttime parade illuminating the park with glowing floats and beloved Disney characters.

festival of fantasy.description: Daytime parade featuring towering floats, Mickey & Friends, Disney Princesses, and the fire-breathing Maleficent dragon.

mickey's philharmagic.description: 4D musical theater show starring Donald Duck stumbling through classic Disney animated songs.

country bear.description: Nashville-style musical revue where the Country Bears perform reimagined Disney classics in bluegrass and country styles.

tiki room.description: Classic Audio-Animatronic tropical serenade performed by singing birds, flowers, and tiki gods.

monsters, inc. laugh floor.description: Interactive live comedy club hosted by Mike Wazowski where animated monsters joke directly with the audience.

luminous.description: EPCOT's nightly fireworks, fountains, lasers, and musical celebration across World Showcase Lagoon.

turtle talk.description: Interactive live Q&A with Crush the sea turtle from Finding Nemo inside the Seas pavilion.

fantasmic.description: Massive outdoor amphitheater nighttime spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse battling Disney Villains with water screens, pyrotechnics, and live stunts.

indiana jones.description: Live action-packed stunt show recreating iconic boulder, fight, and explosion sequences from Raiders of the Lost Ark.

frozen sing-along.description: Hilarious indoor stage retelling of Frozen hosted by the Royal Historians of Arendelle with Anna, Elsa, and Kristoff.

beauty and the beast.description: Broadway-style open-air musical retelling Beauty and the Beast with live singers, dancers, and elaborate costumes.

little mermaid.description: Theatrical musical production bringing Ariel's underwater world to life with puppetry, live vocals, and digital projection effects.

unfairly ever after.description: Live stage spectacular starring Cruella de Vil, Captain Hook, and Maleficent pleading their case through the Magic Mirror.

mickey mouse clubhouse live.description: Upbeat interactive live dance party with Mickey, Minnie, Goofy, Daisy, and Pluto.

festival of the lion king.description: Broadway-caliber indoor theater-in-the-round celebration featuring acrobatics, fire dancers, giant puppets, and live vocals.

finding nemo.description: Live musical puppetry production retelling Finding Nemo from the perspective of the Tank Gang.

better zoogether.description: 4D animated theater show inside the Tree of Life joining Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde across Zootopia's diverse biomes.

feathered friends.description: Live free-flight bird show showcasing Animal Kingdom's avian specialists and exotic birds soaring overhead.
